additional_info.subject: ID0472298-DC/Si-D/FR- [Y2 / P7 312547889/04] Critical Cable Temperature Fault CRM:03289000247
additional_info.body:
Dear Bastien,
Thank you so much for sharing the logs with us.
Following the logs, we have indeed seen the error of the cable temperature sensor.
But after this timestamp, the error didn`t occur again.
if something was really wrong with the Cable temperature sensor, this would show in the error flags, which it does not.
This means, that in that moment, it could have been a bug in the system.
We will monitor the charger for the next three days, to see if the error occurs. After that we will close the ticket.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
